text:
sara: Heads-up - embeddings-prod is spiking 502s since 09:12 UTC, affecting api/v1/embeds. Need a hotfix and a fast approval for a tiny runtime pin + quick config tweak. :rotating_light:
alex: On it. Can you paste the failing log snippet?
sara: here's snippet from staging logs (same repro):```ERROR: kvcache miss overflow -> OOM while building key cache
stack: runtime/kvcache.go:214
```
jay: Recommend pinning to model v2.1-rc3 and rolling a small config change to reduce max_batch_tokens to 1024. That should avoid the kvcache path for now.
maria: +1 to pin and reduce batch. What's the rollback plan if this makes latency worse?
jay: Rollback plan: immediate image revert to previous tag, scale target back to 0.5x, and revert config to max_batch_tokens=4096. I can be on-call to execute.
devops-bot: deploybot: Request to accelerate hotfix deploy received from @jay. Requires 2 approvers or oncall override. To approve, react :thumbsup: or reply `approve`.
sara: tagging @oncall-ops - this is real-user impacting. :eyes:
oncall-ops: I'm awake. Running a quick perf sim now. If numbers hold, I'll approve for expedited window and stand by for rollback.
releasebot: Release note draft created: "hotfix: pin embeddings runtime to v2.1-rc3, temp reduce batch tokens to 1024 to avoid kvcache OOMs; will monitor QPS and latency."
alex: ops checklist before deploy: 1) snapshot current replicas (kubectl get rs), 2) pause autoscaler, 3) apply config map change, 4) image pin, 5) monitor 1min p50/p95 and errors. I'll run 1-4 in that order.
jay: deploy command I'll run (manual):```./infra/deploy --service=embeddings --image=embeddings:v2.1-rc3 --config=embeddings-config-hotfix.yaml --no-canary```
sara: Can we skip canary for speed? Risk is small since change is pin + lower batch size.
oncall-ops: Approve expedited deploy. I've run perf sim: tail latency +5ms, error rate down. I approve.
alex: approve
maria: approve
devops-bot: deploybot: Approval threshold met (3 approvers). Starting deploy runbook. Locking autoscaler and creating annotation: `hotfix/3456789012-expedite`
devops-bot: deploybot: Step 1: snapshot done. Step 2: autoscaler paused. Step 3: applying config...
releasebot: NOTE: publish release note to /releases/hotfix-embeddings-3456789012 after deploy success.
alex: apply complete. image pinned. kicking rollout.
sara: monitoring dashboard: errors dropping in eu-west1, us-east looks steady. p95 increased ~10ms in peak but within SLO. :thumbsup:
devops-bot: deploybot: Rollout succeeded to 100% of traffic. Post-deploy checks: error-rate healthy, CPU stable, kvcache saturated=false.
oncall-ops: Good. Keep an eye for slow tail. If p95 > 200ms for 5m, execute rollback per plan.
jay: I'll keep console open for 30m. If we see regressed latency, I can revert immediately.
maria: I'll open a brief incident note and notify CS for visibility.
sara: Great work. Thanks everyone. Will follow up with a brief postmortem if we need to revert. :heart:
